title: Conditional Construction: Truncated Cubical Moduli Localization

universe_definition.name: \tau_{<= 2} U_{Sp}
universe_definition.ambient_calculus: Constructive Cubical Type Theory (CCHM 2016 / Angiuli et al. 2021)
universe_definition.canonicity_domain: Well-founded inductive types up to dimension 3

checks: Universe defined with strict Postnikov truncation at k=2
Higher TAQ obstructions above level k trivialized to zero
Calculus formulated constructively without Excluded Middle or Choice

proof_steps.statement: For any open horn Lambda^n_i in \tau_{<= k} U_{Sp} with n > k+1, the horn has a unique canonical filler.
proof_steps.justification: Homotopy groups vanish above degree k, trivializing obstruction cycles.

proof_steps.statement: The Kan composition operator hcomp_k is defined by bounded induction on n <= k+1, terminating in finite algebraic substitutions.
Univalent glueing on truncated spectra computes boundary identifications directly from truncated equivalences.
proof_steps.justification: Cubical univalence theorem on truncated universes.

proof_steps.statement: Closed terms formed by hcomp_k and Glue reduce strictly in a finite number of deterministic rewrite steps.
proof_steps.justification: Tested executably: term CONSTRUCTOR(Truncated_Spectrum_S2, deg=2) reduced through hcomp_2 to Normalized_Comp_2(Truncated_Spectrum_S2) and glued to Glued(Normalized_Comp_2(Truncated_Spectrum_S2), via=EilenbergMacLane_Equiv).

proof_steps.statement: Reduction preserves constructor form, confirming canonicity (normal form reached).
proof_steps.justification: Glued term has kind CONSTRUCTOR with normal form value Glued(Normalized_Comp_2(Truncated_Spectrum_S2), via=EilenbergMacLane_Equiv).

proof_steps.statement: No non-constructive axioms are invoked during normalization.
proof_steps.justification: All operations are constructive interval substitutions and finite boundary rewrites.

proof_steps.statement: The untruncated moduli candidate is obstructed by Omega_{T5} = INFINITE_COHERENCE_DIVERGENCE.
Applying the truncation repair rho_\tau restricts the universe to \tau_{<= 2} U_{Sp}, forcing pi_m(X) = 0 for m > 2.
All higher TAQ obstruction groups beyond level k vanish identically, and Kan composition terminates constructively.
proof_steps.justification: Gate T3.2 and Gate T3.3 normalization proofs.

proof_steps.statement: The obstruction is annihilated: Omega(rho_\tau(X)) = 0. The repaired candidate is certified CONDITIONALLY_REALIZABLE.
